proposed.explanation: Technical problem-solving without cultural grounding risks disconnection from what makes Filipino architecture distinctive. Fashion-following would erase the conversations previous architects established. Simple replication would be cultural stasis, not authentic identity. Identity as 'ongoing conversation,' not concluded project. Emerging architects inherit the foundation (Nakpil's cultural consciousness, Mañosa's material integrity, Locsin's synthesis) but must ask new questions: Can digital architecture be Filipino?
